name: Fix migrateToGlobalSequence task containment corruption
description:
CRITICAL hotfix. The `migrateToGlobalSequence` function (packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts, commit b41383c, first shipped @agent-plan/core 0.2.19-next.5) reassembles tasks into phase files using a misaligned index: `numberedTasks[i]` (sorted by createdAt) is paired with `allTasks[i]!.phase.id` (phase-iteration order), so the i-th task by createdAt gets filed under the phase of the i-th task by phase-order. Result: tasks land in wrong phase files (task.phaseId correct, containment wrong). Heca confirmed: 350/359 tasks misfiled after loading next.5.

Fix: reassemble by `task.phaseId` (the source of truth, confirmed correct on heca) instead of by position.

Also add a `rebuildContainment` repair step (group all tasks by their own phaseId, rewrite each phase file's tasks+taskIds) to PlanStore + expose via plan_repair in both adapters, so /planner repair heals corrupted projects. Audit other projects for the same corruption.

Behaviors to preserve: migration idempotency (no-op when numbers already global); deterministic createdAt sort for numbering; phase task order (taskIds).
